items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: oh, Paul Anka. I did Paul Anka.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, you know. One time there -- oh, Paul Anka. I did Paul Anka. I did 5, 6 doubles. I had -- I had -- I had tenor, alto, baritone, bass clarinet, clarinet, flute -- no, 7 doubles ­ - and piccolo. Yep! You know, and you'd be playing and [indiscernible].
And you had to be a very good reader to do that because there wasn't a lot of rehearsal time for those shows to be put together.
